variant.title: Between Lines Sudoku
variant.description: Each line has a circle at both ends. Every other cell on the line must contain a digit between the two circle digits.
rule.between_lines: Each line has a circle at both ends. Every other cell on the line must contain a digit between the two circle digits.
rule_guide.title: Between Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Enter one digit in each circle at the two ends of a line.
rule_guide.item_2: Every other cell on the line must be greater than the smaller circle digit and less than the larger circle digit.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, if the circles contain 2 and 7, the other cells may contain only 3, 4, 5 or 6. Their order does not matter, and not all of them need to appear.
